protected_invariants: the local developer default is preserved exactly: when none of DEV_GENERIC_HTTP_PROXY, DEV_GENERIC_HTTPS_PROXY or DEV_GENERIC_ALL_PROXY is set, the six generic proxy variables in the dev container resolve to the same values they resolved to before this change, so an existing Clash/Mihomo setup on the host gateway keeps working

the override is inert unless a caller sets it: setting DEV_GENERIC_HTTP_PROXY, DEV_GENERIC_HTTPS_PROXY or DEV_GENERIC_ALL_PROXY to a non-empty URL uses that URL, and setting it to the empty string disables that generic proxy, and nothing else in the compose file changes behavior

the compose expansion must use ${VAR-default} semantics, never ${VAR:-default}: the colon form treats a set-but-empty value as unset and would silently restore the default proxy, defeating the explicit CI disable
the uppercase and lowercase spellings of each generic proxy variable are governed by the same override variable, so HTTP_PROXY and http_proxy can never drift apart

provider-specific proxy configuration (PROXY_HOST, WSL2_PROXY_HOST, PROXY_PORT and the PROXY_* family) and The Odds API configuration (THE_ODDS_API_TRANSPORT, THE_ODDS_API_PROXY_URL, THE_ODDS_API_KEY) are unchanged, byte for byte, by this mission

CI is not weakened: no Gatekeeper bypass, no npm error suppression, no continue-on-error on the dependency-install or Gatekeeper steps, no retry loop that hides the deterministic configuration defect, no weakening of validation_profiles.py or scripts/devops/gatekeeper.sh, and no change to the required check set

the defect is not papered over by a one-off hostname patch: registry.npmjs.org (or any single registry hostname) is not added to NO_PROXY, no fake proxy server is started, the npm registry is not switched to an unrelated mirror, and npm failures are not ignored

the regression test is falsifiable: it must fail if a generic proxy line in docker-compose.dev.yml is changed from ${VAR-default} to ${VAR:-default}, if a generic proxy line loses its override variable, or if the workflow stops supplying the CI disable override
